absence_rule: When the authored run receipt is absent, the optional public projection must also be absent; this historical/future profile does not block the current governed Codex v3 release.
projection_rule: Only after a new explicit user decision, when a future run is present and valid, is the authored run receipt projected byte-for-byte after schema, bounded material, exact attempt/role, exhaustive terminal-outcome, one-to-one acceptance-proof, deterministic revalidation, usage and closed cost-reconciliation validation.
